correctness.rationale: Parity and polynomial degree bound Walsh support; explicit harmonic witnesses attain each nonempty proper character; the null-vector Taylor calculation proves every even constant mode after quadratic degree. The top-character degree \(d+2\) sign projection is forced to \(x_1\cdots x_d\) times a trace-zero quadratic, hence vanishes at all sign vertices. These yield exactly the rank formula for every \(d\ge3\), \(0\le k\le d+2\). Exact rational Gegenbauer/Krawtchouk calculations independently corroborate dimensions 3..12 but are not used for infinite proof.
